children: Mobix Labs announced multiple financing actions to strengthen liquidity and flexibility. The company issued a $1.2 million senior secured convertible note to Leviston Resources at 10% interest, maturing Dec 25, 2026, with a conversion feature subject to stockholder approval. Mobix also amended related Leviston agreements, including securities purchase, investor rights, and registration rights, to support the financing and register conversion shares. Separately, Mobix amended its agreement with Kips Bay Select, selling Series A 10% Convertible Preferred Stock, issuing a warrant for up to 6,000 additional preferred shares at $1,000 per share, and providing 834,782 Extension Shares; conversions remain subject to Nasdaq rules and stockholder approval. The company expanded Kips registration rights to cover conversions.
